pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Waving Outside Town Hall in Her New Leaf Spring Uniform Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle waving outside Town Hall in her New Leaf spring uniform, with a checked vest and bow. Her bell-tied hair and smiling face dominate the coloring sheet, while the clock tower, tiled path, flowers, and picket fence add smaller background sections.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Reading a Book in Her New Leaf Winter Uniform at the Town Hall Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle reads at the Town Hall desk in this printable coloring page, wearing her New Leaf winter uniform with a large collar bow. An open book fills the foreground, with upright books and a desk lamp on either side. The coloring sheet combines broad facial areas with narrow page edges and jacket trim.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Welcoming a Villager Beside Tom Nook in Her New Horizons Aloha Shirt Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle welcoming a backpacked villager beside Tom Nook, both wearing leaf-patterned aloha shirts outside the Resident Services building. Isabelle gestures toward the visitor beneath the building's leaf emblem. Shirt motifs, paneled doors, and paving stones give this coloring sheet its smaller details.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Watering the Office Flowers in Her New Horizons Winter Sweater Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle waters office flowers in this printable coloring page, wearing her New Horizons winter sweater with snowflakes, zigzag bands, and a bow. She tips a flower-decorated watering can toward three blooms. Books, pinned notes, and a snowy window provide a setting around the main figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Making the Morning Island Announcement Into Her Desk Microphone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle making the morning island announcement into a desk microphone while holding a sheet of paper at her desk. Her aloha shirt has outlined leaf motifs, and a pencil cup and stacked books flank the workspace. Large facial spaces balance the microphone grille and stationery details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Taking a Coffee Break Beside a Stack of Resident Services Paperwork Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle takes a coffee break in this printable coloring page, holding a large mug beside a stack of Resident Services paperwork at her desk. Her leaf-patterned shirt, bell hair tie, and smiling expression stand out against office shelves and a window. The coloring sheet includes broad furniture panels and smaller stationery shapes.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Dozing in Her Office Chair Behind the Resident Services Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Animal Crossing Isabelle dozing in her office chair behind the Resident Services counter, with closed eyes and her head tilted. Her paws rest on the armrests above a broad desk mat. Books, a mug, and potted plants frame the quiet office scene on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Dusting the Resident Services Shelves with a Feather Duster Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle dusts the Resident Services shelves in this printable coloring page, extending a feather duster toward binders while wearing her leaf-patterned aloha shirt. A potted plant sits above the files, with a storage box below. The coloring sheet leaves generous open areas around Isabelle's skirt, ears, and the shelf compartments.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Singing the Island Tune Beside a Board of Musical Notes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle singing the island tune beside a wooden board of musical notes, smiling with her eyes closed and arms raised. Smiling note symbols fill the staff, while more notes float around her hair. Small flowers and grass tufts complete the outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Showing a Villager a Custom Island Flag at Resident Services Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle presents a custom island flag to a smiling villager at Resident Services in this printable coloring page, with a leaf emblem and stars. The villager wears a cloud-patterned shirt beside the office counter. A telephone, calendar, and file cabinet add smaller background details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Reviewing a Five-star Island Evaluation with a Happy Villager Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle reviewing a five-star island evaluation with a happy villager, holding a clipboard displaying stars above an island map. Both characters smile with closed eyes, and their shirts carry floral and leaf patterns. The clipboard's trees, house, and winding river provide compact details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Presenting the Golden Watering Can to the Mayor in New Leaf Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle presents the golden watering can to the mayor in this printable coloring page, with the New Leaf Town Hall and clock behind them. Both hold the can above a stone-paved plaza. Isabelle's bow and the mayor's checked jacket supply small outlined sections within the larger figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Cheering as the Mayor Plants the Town Tree Sapling Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle cheering as the mayor plants the town tree sapling, with raised paws and a wide smile nearby. The mayor holds a shovel beside the leafy young tree. Paving stones, a streetlamp, and part of Town Hall form the setting around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Checking a Town Map Beside Lloid at a New Public Works Site Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle checks a town map beside Lloid in this printable coloring page, standing within a rope-marked public works site while he wears a hard hat. Her folded map shows houses, trees, a bridge, and a winding river. The coloring sheet contrasts broad character shapes with twisted ropes and small map symbols.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Celebrating a Completed Stone Bridge with Villagers and Party Poppers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle celebrating a completed stone bridge with villagers and party poppers, with confetti rising above their smiling faces. A rabbit holds another popper while a squirrel clasps its paws nearby. The bridge's arched blocks and riverbanks add background detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Giving the Mayor a Sapling Clock at the Town Anniversary Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle gives the mayor a sapling clock in this printable coloring page, standing beneath the town anniversary bunting beside a broad tree trunk. The tree-shaped clock has a round face surrounded by outlined leaves. Isabelle's checked vest and the mayor's suit offer smaller sections within this celebratory coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Ordering Takeaway Coffee From Brewster at the Roost Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Animal Crossing Isabelle ordering takeaway coffee from Brewster at the Roost, reaching toward a lidded cup across the cafe counter. Brewster wears round glasses, a bow tie, and an apron beside a coffee pot. Bar stools and hanging lighting complete the indoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Listening to K.k. Slider Play Guitar in the Island Plaza Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle listens to K.K. Slider play guitar in the island plaza in this printable coloring page, seated beside him with her paws folded. Guitar strings and frets create fine details against the instrument's open body. The plaza clock, flag, and stone paving surround the two characters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Doing Group Stretching Beside Tom Nook and the Plaza Radio Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle doing group stretching beside Tom Nook and the plaza radio, both smiling with arms extended in aloha shirts. The portable radio sits between them beneath the Resident Services clock. Leaf motifs, shirt buttons, and rows of plaza paving add repeated details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Working Inside Her Camper Van at the Welcome Amiibo Campground Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle works inside her camper van at the Welcome Amiibo campground in this printable coloring page, holding a pencil over paper at a folding table. The open doorway reveals shelves, a curtain, and a hanging lantern. Large van panels and tires frame the smaller office and camping details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Welcoming a New Campsite Manager in Animal Crossing Pocket Camp Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle welcoming a new campsite manager in Pocket Camp, waving beside a backpacked camper beneath a wooden entrance frame. A tent and lantern stand behind them, while the manager wears a leaf-emblem cap and hiking boots. The coloring sheet includes open clothing areas and rope bindings.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Collecting Pinwheetles Beside Morning Glories During Her Pocket Camp Garden Gathering Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle collects Pinwheetles beside morning glories in this printable coloring page, holding a raised insect net during her Pocket Camp garden gathering outdoors. One insect sits inside the net and another rests on a flower. Heart-shaped leaves, curling vines, and a watering can fill the garden portion of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Showing the Designer a Classroom Plan in Happy Home Designer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle presenting a classroom plan to the designer in Happy Home Designer, pointing at a floor plan on a table. Rows of miniature desks appear in the drawing, echoed by larger desks beneath the classroom board. The designer's apron and Isabelle's uniform have broad open sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Relaxing on the Seaside Terrace of Her Happy Home Paradise Vacation Home Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle relaxes on the seaside terrace of her Happy Home Paradise vacation home in this printable coloring page, holding a cup in a woven chair. Her floral blouse and tied skirt sit against a view of ocean water and an island. The coloring sheet includes chair weaving, palm fronds, and a potted hibiscus.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Rolling a Large Die on the Amiibo Festival Board-game Path Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle rolling a large die along an Amiibo Festival board-game path, wearing a dress covered with outlined polka dots. Leaf and star symbols mark the winding spaces behind her. An apple tree, small house, and flowers give this coloring sheet additional shapes around the oversized die.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Driving a Kart Past Fruit Trees on the Mario Kart Animal Crossing Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle drives a kart past fruit trees in this printable coloring page, gripping the steering wheel on the Mario Kart Animal Crossing course. Her kart carries a leaf emblem across its broad front panel. Apples, oranges, roadside flowers, and a distant house surround the curving road on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Casting Her Fishing Rod on the Smashville Stage in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle casting her fishing rod on the Smashville stage in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, with a bobber suspended nearby. She stands on a rope-edged wooden platform above a village landscape. The coloring sheet includes the rod's reel, a clock-front building, an apple tree, and a bridge.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Floating Above Town and City on Her Balloon Swing in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle floats above Town and City on her balloon swing in this printable coloring page, holding the ropes beneath three large balloons overhead. Her legs hang from a narrow wooden seat above the stage scenery. Broad balloon interiors contrast with small houses, trees, and the river bridge on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Enjoying a Picnic in Her Pink Polka-dot Amiibo Festival Dress Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle enjoying a picnic in her polka-dot Amiibo Festival dress, holding a triangular sandwich on a checked blanket. A woven basket, apple, and mug sit beside her beneath an apple tree. The coloring sheet combines large dress spots with smaller basket squares and flower petals.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Presenting Rice Cakes Beside the Girl's Day Doll Display Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle presents rice cakes beside a Girl's Day doll display in this printable coloring page, holding a tray with neatly stacked rectangular layers. Two larger dolls sit above three smaller figures between lanterns and flowering branches. Their fans, robes, and folding screen add fine sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Wearing a Yukata and Flower Bopper Beneath the Summer Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle wearing a floral yukata and flower bopper beneath summer fireworks, holding a small tied pouch in both paws. Her sandals and wide sleeves frame the patterned robe, while three bursts spread across the sky. Outlined petals and firework trails create smaller spaces throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Reviewing Custom Firework Patterns with a Villager Before the Fireworks Show Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle reviews custom firework patterns with a villager in this printable coloring page, pointing to an open design book before the fireworks show. Flower, star, and spiral patterns fill its pages beneath a string of hanging lanterns. Their patterned shirts and the plaza paving add further detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Wearing a Tuxedo and Waving a Light Stick Beside the New Year's Eve Countdown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle wearing a tuxedo and waving a light stick beside the New Year's Eve countdown clock in the plaza. A large bow decorates the clock stand, with confetti and stars floating around her raised paw. Her jacket lapels, buttons, and bow tie create distinct clothing sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Holding a Zodiac Animal Figurine Beside the New Year's Day Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle holds a zodiac animal figurine beside the New Year's Day photo standee in this printable coloring page, supporting a small decorated cow. Bamboo stalks, blossoms, and a fan surround the standee's oval opening. Her checked skirt and the figurine's floral markings add patterned areas to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Wearing a Striped Mage's Hat Beside Halloween Pumpkins at Resident Services Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Animal Crossing Isabelle wearing a striped mage's hat beside Halloween pumpkins at Resident Services, smiling between two carved jack-o'-lanterns outside. The hat's curved tip and broad bands rise above her hair, while the building's clock and arched windows frame the coloring sheet behind her.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Wearing a Santa Hat Beside a Decorated Cedar Tree on Toy Day Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle wears a Santa hat beside a decorated cedar tree on Toy Day in this printable coloring page, standing with her paws clasped together. Round baubles, garlands, bows, and a star cover the tree. A wrapped gift rests in the snow below, adding ribbon sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Wearing a Festivale Feather Accessory Behind the Resident Services Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle wearing a Festivale feather accessory behind the Resident Services counter, with three long feathers attached beside her bun. A flower-shaped ornament and trailing ribbons decorate the headpiece above her checked vest. The desk microphone, paper, books, and potted plant complete this office coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Showing a Globe Beside the Nature Day Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle displays a globe beside the Nature Day photo standee in this printable coloring page, resting a paw above the mounted sphere outdoors. Continental outlines cover the globe on a small round table. The tree-shaped standee, scattered flowers, and Isabelle's checked vest provide additional sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Giving a Shamrock Hat to a Villager Beside the Shamrock Day Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle giving a shamrock hat to a squirrel villager beside the Shamrock Day photo standee, decorated with a rainbow. The tall hat carries a clover above its buckle, matching the standee's motifs. The squirrel's curled tail and flower-trimmed dress add rounded shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Holding a Newsprint Helmet Beneath Carp Banners on Children's Day Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle holds a newsprint helmet beneath carp banners on Children's Day in this printable coloring page, smiling below three fish-shaped streamers overhead outdoors. The folded helmet has angular panels between her paws, while overlapping scales cover the banners. These repeated curves contrast with her checked vest on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Offering an Ogre Mask Beside the Bean Day Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Animal Crossing Isabelle offering an ogre mask beside the Bean Day photo standee, with striped horns and pointed teeth outlined. The standee shows a matching horned figure above a wooden box of beans. Broad face openings balance the small beans and patterned loincloth on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Wearing Ladder Shades Beside the Summer Solstice Sunflower Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle wears ladder shades beside the Summer Solstice sunflower photo standee in this printable coloring page, raising one paw beneath an outlined sun. Horizontal slats cross her oversized glasses beside the standee's large oval opening. The sunflower petals, leaves, and simple uniform provide broad coloring areas throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Holding a Wheat Bundle Beneath the Full Moon at the Autumn Moon Festival Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle holding a wheat bundle beneath the full moon at the Autumn Moon Festival, with lanterns hanging behind her. Fine outlines separate the grains above the tied stems. A pumpkin, extra wheat, and a plate of skewered treats surround the main figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Holding a Glow Stick Beside the Winter Solstice Snowman Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle holds a glow stick beside the Winter Solstice snowman photo standee in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a crescent moon and stars. The snowman wears a top hat and scarf around its face opening. Large snowy areas contrast with Isabelle's ribbed cardigan trim and bow on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Standing Beside Bamboo Decorated with Wishes on Starcrossed Day Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle standing beside bamboo decorated with wishes on Starcrossed Day, clasping her paws below a sky of stars. Rectangular wish slips, diamond chains, and hanging stars decorate the potted stalk. Narrow bamboo leaves and the small ribbons contrast with Isabelle's broad ears on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Displaying an Eggplant Cow and Cucumber Horse at the Obon Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle displays an eggplant cow and cucumber horse at the Obon celebration in this printable coloring page, extending both arms above a table. Each vegetable rests on stick legs beneath a hanging paper lantern. The cucumber's small markings and the eggplant's leaf cap add detail to this otherwise open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Thanking Franklin Beside the Harvest Festival Cooking Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle thanking Franklin beside the Harvest Festival cooking table, clasping her paws near a steaming pot of food. Franklin wears a tall chef's hat, neckerchief, and double-breasted coat. A pumpkin and mushrooms sit on the table, adding distinct rounded shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Holding a Resetti Model Beside the Groundhog Day Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle holds a Resetti model beside the Groundhog Day photo standee in this printable coloring page, supporting the figurine on a small base. Resetti wears overalls and a miner's helmet, while the standee has whiskers and large front teeth. Their small facial details contrast with the open ground and sky on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Holding a Holiday Stocking Beside the Naughty-or-nice Day Photo Standee Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle holding a holiday stocking beside the Naughty-or-Nice Day photo standee, shaped like Santa with a large beard. The stocking has a star motif, a broad cuff, and outlined heel and toe sections. A ribboned gift and snowdrifts complete the winter coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle and Digby Celebrating Their Shared Birthday Beside a Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle and Digby celebrate their shared birthday beside a cake in this printable coloring page, smiling with their paws raised near their chests. Three striped candles stand above the cake's scalloped icing, and two balloons float behind the pair. Their uniform buttons and the cake decorations supply small sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Isabelle Holding Coffee Mug at Window Coloring Page
pages.description: Standing at an open wooden window, Isabelle from Animal Crossing holds a steaming mug inside her cozy room in this detailed printable coloring page.

pages.title: Isabelle Kawaii Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing's Isabelle leans forward with a soft smile and her paw near her cheek on this printable coloring page. Two floating hearts hover above her signature topknot and skirt outfit. Color this clear line art using Ibis Paint X or colored pencils.

pages.title: Isabelle Winking Cute Coloring Page
pages.description: Isabelle from Animal Crossing strikes a cheerful pose, winking with one hand near her cheek. Wearing a plaid vest and bow, she is framed by sparkling star accents and diagonal lines on this printable coloring page. Ideal for coloring with fine-liners or alcohol markers.

pages.title: Cute Isabelle Animal Crossing Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute Isabelle from Animal Crossing smiles happily in a plaid dress with a matching hair bow. This printable coloring page shows her jumping among small floating stars. Finish the detailed line art with colored pencils or gel pens.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle in Aquarium Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Animal Crossing Isabelle waving in an aquarium room, with fish, bubbles, aquatic plants, and coral visible through a large tank behind her. Wall shelves hold a fish ornament and a smaller bowl beside more coral shapes. Isabelle's vest and skirt offer open spaces amid the underwater details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle Near Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle stands near a waterfall in this printable coloring page, holding an apple beside a pool beneath two rocky cascades surrounded by plants. Flowers, leafy trees, reeds, and scattered stones frame her uniformed figure. The coloring sheet includes flowing water lines and small foliage sections around Isabelle's broad ears and face.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle in Crafting Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing Isabelle in a crafting workshop, working over a small board with tools, scissors, and a yarn ball nearby. Wood grain covers the worktables, with hanging garden tools and a toolbox behind her. Glasses hang from her collar above the smaller craft supplies on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle in Picnic Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing Isabelle sits in a picnic area in this printable coloring page, resting on a bordered blanket beside a basket of sandwiches, an apple, and a flask. A cup and saucer stand in the foreground below her buttoned cardigan. Leafy trees and distant hills leave an open outdoor backdrop on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Isabelle at Flea Market Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Animal Crossing Isabelle at a flea market, holding a leaf-emblem shopping bag in front of a stall filled with goods. A watering can, teddy bear, books, and a small leaf-shaped ornament line the table. The striped canopy and tiny background shoppers add further details to the coloring sheet.
